mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 1300k and retail sales above 700k indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST>1300k and RSAFS>700k) occurs in more than 50% of cases with negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, industrial production growth above 102.0 (INDPRO > 102.0) signals manufacturing momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO exceeds 102.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 22900 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 22900) indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 22900, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 300 (CPIAUCSL > 300) indicates high inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 300, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high-inflation periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 158000 (PAYEMS > 158000) signals strong labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 158000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rates above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03.
